item_name: Rothco Navy Mesh Back Tactical Cap - Black
item_short_desc: Rothco's Navy Mesh Back Tactical Cap is a comfortable baseball style cap with raised embroidered Navy letttering.
description: Rothco's Navy Mesh Back Tactical Cap is a comfortable baseball style cap with raised embroidered Navy lettering. Along with reinforced air vent holes, Rothco's Navy hat has 4 polyester mesh panels and 2 cotton front panels to keep you cool. The tactical cap features a color matching hook & loop adjustment strap, sandwich style brim, upper brim with Navy direct embroidery, and a brushed cotton twill sweatband.
